_doc: Release manifest: every (cell, arch) result with its evaluation and HPO artifacts. See README.md. `rule_completed`: the number of non-pruned trials at which the paper's convergence rule holds for the study's group (tools/hpo_compute.py); a study file may hold later trials in some cases. `gpu_seconds_correction`: re-timed minus recorded duration of trials that had shared a GPU. 'paper' gives the tables and figures (LaTeX labels) in the manuscript.
